personality.description: This person is usually energetic and socially engaged, often starting conversations, keeping groups lively, and speaking with ease. They tend to keep a moderate level of structure in daily routines, staying fairly organized while still leaving room for flexibility and occasional new experiences. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually try to find a fair, practical compromise, but will state their own view clearly if they believe something important is at stake. In group discussions, their style is open and expressive, with enough confidence to persuade others while still showing some willingness to listen and cooperate.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
